The number of hours an extension version must have been published before it is available for install or update from the Marketplace. Set to 0 to disable the cooldown. Useful as a buffer against compromised or accidentally-published versions; lowers your exposure to brand-new releases by deferring install until the version has been in the Marketplace for at least this long.
